author: Athul Prem
convention: Each power is a fraction of incident power. The means average five equal-power incoherent inputs. Displayed powers are percentages, while contrasts and signed differences are percentage points. The midpoint deviation subtracts the average of the two endpoint values. Native drive identities are matched at the samples separately for each thickness. The mean contrast needs no cross-thickness match.
scope: Finite 995, 997.5 and 1000 MHz responses at the original end planes. The two mesh families also differ in hole faceting. The sampled chord deviations establish no bound between samples or in the continuum.
